run_evaluation_on_dataset: run evaluation on a trained HMR model against h36m-p1, 3dpw, or mpi-inf-3dhp datasets using a checkpoint file
run_evaluation_function: run the run_evaluation function with a model, dataset name, and dataset object to compute MPJPE and reconstruction error metrics
eval_main_entry: run eval_main with a list of CLI arguments to load a checkpoint and evaluate across multiple datasets
evaluate_3d_pose_metrics: evaluate 3D pose estimation quality by computing MPJPE and PA-MPJPE reconstruction error on Human3.6M or 3DPW datasets
save_evaluation_results: save SMPL pose, betas, camera, and predicted joints to an npz file using the result_file argument
